How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard?
version:3.1.0
IP:192.168.11.33
API name: get nodes list
Parameter_fabricName:PEK-ACI

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to retrieve a list of nodes associated with a specified fabric in a network. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to send the GET request to. The URL should include the target IP, API endpoint, and the fabricName query parameter placeholder https://<ip>/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName={fabricName}.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric whose nodes are to be listed. This value is used to replace the {fabricName} placeholder in the URL.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard? version:3.1.0 IP:192.168.11.33 API name: get nodes list Parameter_fabricName:PEK-ACI"

We need to use the function to send a GET request. The function expects url and fabricName. The URL template: "https://<ip>/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName={fabricName}". We have IP 192.168.11.33, fabricName PEK-ACI.

So we call functions.requests_get with url: "https://192.168.11.33/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName=PEK-ACI" and fabricName: "PEK-ACI". But the function signature includes both url and fabricName. The url already contains placeholder but we can supply full URL. The function will likely replace placeholder? It says "The URL should include the target IP, API endpoint, and the fabricName query parameter placeholder https://<ip>/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName={fabricName}." So we can pass url with placeholder and fabricName param. But we can also pass full URL. Let's follow spec: Provide url with placeholder and fabricName param. So:

{
"url": "https://192.168.11.33/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/nodes?fabricName={fabricName}",
"fabricName": "PEK-ACI"
}

But the function might replace placeholder. We'll do that.

Thus we call function.
